---------

They say Revelation can’t be decoded… yet Hollywood can’t stop making movies about the very events it describes.

From apocalyptic blockbusters to end-of-the-world thrillers, the media paints its own version of the final days — full of explosions, chaos, and fear. But the Bible’s book of Revelation tells the true story… one filled with symbols, warnings, and hope for those who follow the Lamb.

In this video, we take you through Revelation explained verse by verse — unlocking its hidden meanings, exposing the difference between Hollywood’s fiction and God’s truth, and showing why this prophetic book is more relevant than ever, and how it really is a love story between Jesus and His people. The focus of Revelation is the plan of salvation.
